# Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.132

[![Support on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support_on_Ko--fi-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/utkiduck)

![Fighting Force Recharged 0.0.132 release poster](https://github.com/mbushuev/fighting-force-recharged/releases/download/v0.0.132/FightingForceRecharged-0.0.132-Poster.png)

Separate item controls, an in-game move list and repaired scenery for the
original Windows version of **Fighting Force (1997)**. This update also fixes
custom-camera visibility around Subway tracks and inside train carriages.

## New in this version

- **Separate pickup and throw/drop:** use F/RB to pick up weapons, throwable
  items and detachable scenery, including elevator rails. Use R/LB to throw or
  drop held items. Punch stays an attack; Kick and Backfist retain held items.
  Nearby pickup prompts show the currently assigned key or button. Native
  reach, character restrictions, pickup animations and automatic consumables
  remain in charge. Turn Separate Pickup OFF to restore pickup with Punch.
- **Updated controller layout:** B retains native Backfist and enemy grabbing;
  LT blocks when enabled and RT runs. D-pad up/down zooms and left/right turns
  the camera without moving the player. Camera turning is remappable and
  respects each cooperative player's view. Two-button controller chords can
  also be assigned, with complete chords taking priority over single buttons.
- **Per-player Move List:** open it from pause or Options to browse all four
  heroes' native attacks, combos, grabs, weapons and item interactions. It
  shows applied button assignments, distinguishes sequences from simultaneous
  presses, and labels disabled guard or unavailable bindings. Browsing from
  pause keeps the game paused.
- **Complete Rooms:** an optional Gameplay Settings switch fills selected
  exposed boundaries in the elevator, first boss office, later laboratory lift,
  laboratory, shopping center and ship. It also completes Subway entrance
  pilasters and Bronx facade returns, with scenery beyond the Bronx
  intersection. Added walls reuse installed materials and obstruct the orbit
  camera; original passages, scripts and actor collision zones are preserved.
- **Camera visibility fixes:** train interiors and exteriors remain visible
  when turning backward or moving inside a carriage. Floor tiles are clipped
  at view limits. Subway's recessed track walls no longer cover the foreground
  platform, including at low camera angles.
- **Recognizable save locations:** campaign slots, Continue previews and pause
  save status display the original English level names.

## Default controls and upgrading

| Action | Keyboard and mouse | Xbox / XInput |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | WASD | Left stick |
| Pick up item / detach scenery | F | RB |
| Throw / drop held item | R | LB |
| Backfist / native enemy grab | E | B |
| Run | Hold Shift | Hold RT |
| Block, when enabled | Hold Q | Hold LT |
| Look | Mouse | Right stick |
| Camera distance | Mouse wheel | D-pad up / down |
| Additional horizontal camera turn | Remappable | D-pad left / right |
| First-person / third-person view | Tab | L3 |

Unchanged older default pad layouts migrate together. Customized assignments
are preserved; conflicting new actions remain unbound until assigned in
**Options > Controller Settings**. The Move List and pickup prompts show the
applied bindings. Separate Pickup and Complete Rooms default to ON; Player
Block remains optional and OFF by default.

## Install or update

1. Extract **FightingForceRecharged-0.0.132-Windows.zip**.
2. Close the game and run **FightingForceSetup.exe**.
3. Choose **Add fix to existing game folder** and select the folder containing
   **fforce.exe**, or **Install game from original disc** for a new installation.
4. Start **fforce.exe** from the installed game folder.

Setup preserves existing settings, campaign saves and original game files.
New settings use their defaults when absent from an existing configuration.
Requires **Windows 10/11 x64** and the supported **English PC retail or reviewed
English RIP** executable. The retail edition needs its original mounted disc.
The reviewed RIP retains its supplied missing intro/music; original mounted
audio media can supply CD music. No game files or disc images are included
or downloaded by setup.

## Validation and limits

The Subway strip was reproduced and its repair confirmed in gameplay. Bronx
reconstruction received gameplay inspection; spot checks of Subway Boss,
the later lift, laboratory, mall and ship found no obvious issues. Native
retail/RIP fixtures and independent coverage checks exercise the affected
rendering paths. These checks cover the reviewed repairs, not every campaign
surface or camera configuration.

Free orbit, first-person view, dynamic split screen and interpolated rendering
remain experimental. Extended two-controller and full-campaign coverage remain
incomplete. Complete Rooms affects selected areas only; added doors are scenery.
Native combat timing, damage, progression and actor collision zones remain
unchanged. Campaign saves restore level entry rather than a mid-fight state.

The local release build runs runtime and installer checks, audits exact package
contents and verifies archive checksums. **release.json** records the source
commit and artifact hashes; **SHA256SUMS.txt** lists the download checksums.
**Source.zip** contains project source, not game data. The installer and wrapper
are not code-signed.
